# Coverage by language

Each page lists what CrossTL translates to and from one language, measured on commit [`52c8879`](https://github.com/CrossGL/crosstl/commit/52c8879d0a023f757943283413208e345a54f854) at 2026-11-26T04:55:56Z (CrossTL 3.9.0). CI probes every feature of a pinned upstream feature list, checks each translation with the language's reference compiler or validator and, where it has a runtime for the language, runs it. [COVERAGE.md](../COVERAGE.md) has the same numbers for every language on one page.
